steps: In a small bowl, mix the chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and black pepper.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Season both sides of the chicken with salt, then rub the spices all over.
Heat the oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat. When the oil is shimmery, add the chicken. Cook, uncovered, until golden, about 3 minutes.

Flip the chicken and reduce the heat to low. Add ¼ cup of water to the skillet and cover with a lid (or tuck aluminum foil around the chicken). Cook until an instant-read thermometer reads 75°C in the thickest part of the breast, 10 to 15 minutes.

Transfer the chicken to the plate and cover loosely with foil. Leave the chicken to rest for 5 minutes. Slice the chicken into thick pieces and serve it drizzled with the pan drippings and lemon wedges.

notes: The first part of the cooking process can be a bit messy, so if you have an oil mesh to put over the skillet, do so!

recipe_info.title: Skillet chicken breasts
recipe_info.intro: An easy way to cook chicken breast on the stovetop, useful for any recipe that calls for chicken!
